title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced Senior Manufacturing Engineer with a
strong background in aerospace or precision manufacturing?

Do you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, improving
manufacturing processes and supporting other engineers to deliver
continuous improvement?

We're supporting a leading engineering and manufacturing business
in Fareham who are looking for an experienced Senior
Manufacturing Engineer to join their Operations team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys combining
hands-on manufacturing engineering, process development and
technical leadership within a high-mix, low-volume manufacturing
environment.

What's the role all about?

As the Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you'll play a key role in
improving manufacturing processes, supporting production and
ensuring products are manufactured safely, efficiently and to the
highest quality standards.

You'll work closely with Production, Design Engineering and
Operations, providing technical expertise across New Product
Introduction (NPI), process improvement, tooling design and
manufacturing readiness.

You'll also support and mentor fellow Manufacturing Engineers,
helping to develop technical capabilities and promote a strong
continuous improvement culture.

This isn't simply a production support role. You'll have the
opportunity to influence how products are manufactured, introduce
new processes and drive long-term improvements across the
business.

What will you be doing?

* Provide technical leadership, coaching and support to
Manufacturing Engineers and Production teams
* Improve manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, quality
and productivity
* Support existing production lines, resolving technical issues
and minimising downtime
* Design and develop manufacturing tooling, fixtures and
processing equipment

* Lead process development projects from concept through to
production handover
* Champion Design for Manufacture (DFM) during New Product
Introduction
* Work closely with Design Engineering to improve product
manufacturability
* Conduct Design of Experiments (DOE) to improve process
capability, yield and cycle times
* Implement PFMEA, Control Plans and Statistical Process Control
(SPC)

* Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities and improve
first-pass yield
* Lead technical problem-solving and 8D investigations

* Carry out Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance
Testing (SAT) for new equipment and processes
* Develop manufacturing documentation, training packages and
process instructions
* Support risk assessments and ensure new tooling and processes
meet Health & Safety requirements
* Identify opportunities to reduce waste, manufacturing costs and
production cycle times
* Develop capital investment proposals to support new technology
and capacity improvements
* Lead continuous improvement activities including Kaizen events

* Work with suppliers to resolve technical manufacturing issues
What do you need?

We're looking for someone with:

* Master's Degree or equivalent in Engineering
* 5–10 years' relevant engineering experience
* 3–5 years' experience within aerospace or a similar high-mix,
low-volume manufacturing environment
* Strong background in Manufacturing Engineering and process
development

* Experience in product development and New Product Introduction
* Good understanding of GD&T and CAD

* Experience with metal fabrication and surface treatment
processes

* Knowledge of FMEA and structured problem-solving techniques

* Proven experience leading 8D investigations or improvement
projects

* Experience working within an AS9100 environment

* Strong data analysis and technical problem-solving skills
* Project management experience
* Experience using programming and analysis software
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to coach and
train others
Desirable

It would also be beneficial if you have:

* Experience with SAP or other ERP systems

* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma

* Experience within a machining workshop
* CNC machining experience
* Strong practical experience using CAD for tooling and process
development
About you

You'll be someone who enjoys getting involved in the detail of
manufacturing and finding better ways of doing things.

You'll be:

* Technically confident and solutions-focused
* Proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement
* Comfortable leading technical discussions
* A strong problem solver
* Analytical and data-driven
* Confident coaching and mentoring other engineers
* Organised and capable of managing multiple projects
* Comfortable challenging existing processes
* Collaborative when working with Production, Quality and Design
teams
* Passionate about continuous improvement
Most importantly, you'll understand that successful Manufacturing
Engineering isn't just about fixing problems when they occur –
it's about developing processes that prevent them from happening
in the first place.

Why join?

This is an opportunity to join an established engineering and
manufacturing business where you'll have a genuine influence on
how products are manufactured.

You'll work across production support, tooling design, process
development and NPI, giving you exposure to a broad range of
engineering challenges.

You'll also have the opportunity to support and develop other
engineers while driving improvements in manufacturing
performance, quality and efficiency.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Lead
Manufacturing Engineer, Manufacturing Process Engineer or Senior
Production Engineer with a background in aerospace or high-mix,
low-volume manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Kingdom People for a confidential
discussion.

Kingdom People are acting as an Employment Agency in relation to
this vacancy.
